title: 東京有明水再生中心~Tokyo Ariake Water Reclamation Center
focus: A₂O、生物膜過濾與非飲用回用~A₂O, biofilm filtration and nonpotable reuse
summary: 有明的公開流程具有厭氧、無氧、好氧與生物膜過濾，部分出水另作回用。課程讓學徒區分水質處理鏈與再生水用途鏈。~Ariake documents anaerobic, anoxic, aerobic and biofilm-filter processes, with a portion further treated for reuse. The learner separates treatment and end-use chains.

units.title: 分流污水入口：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Separate-sewer influent: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「分流污水入口」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at separate-sewer influent.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「分流污水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for separate-sewer influent; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「分流污水入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the separate-sewer influent measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 反應槽停留：水力停留時間~Reactor retention: Hydraulic retention time
units.mechanism: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「反應槽停留」觀察此因果關係。~Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at reactor retention.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
units.verify: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「反應槽停留」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for reactor retention; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。~V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
units.practice: 先點選「反應槽停留」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the reactor retention measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: A₂O內回流：內回流與水力負荷~A₂O internal recycle: Internal recirculation and hydraulic load
units.mechanism: 回流把反應物帶回前段，也增加管線與反應區通過量；回流率不是污染物去除率。本單元在「A₂O內回流」觀察此因果關係。~Recirculation returns reactants upstream while increasing pipe and zone throughput; recycle ratio is not removal efficiency. Examine this relationship at A₂O internal recycle.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水Q=1000 m³/d、內回流Qr=2000 m³/d。公式 Qzone=Q+Qr；代入 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d。適用邊界：只計指定區域的循環水力負荷；外部排放仍須另作平衡。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: influentQ=1000 m³/d and internal recycleQr=2000 m³/d. Formula Qzone=Q+Qr; substitution 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d. Boundary: Hydraulic throughput of one specified zone only; external discharge has a separate balance.
units.verify: 在流路圖分開標示內回流與真正出水，避免重複計量。在離線場景為「A₂O內回流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Mark internal recycle separately from final effluent to avoid double counting. Build an offline evidence table for A₂O internal recycle; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把回流水加到整廠外部出水會造成假性水量增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Adding recycled flow to external effluent creates fictitious water production. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 內回流量越大等於淨產水越多。~Greater internal recycle means more net water production.
units.practice: 先點選「A₂O內回流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qr改成3000 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4000 m³/d。與基準 3000 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the A₂O internal recycle measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qr to3000 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4000 m³/d. Compare with baseline 3000 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 好氧區氨轉化：硝化的氧需求收支~Aerobic ammonia conversion: Oxygen balance for nitrification
units.mechanism: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「好氧區氨轉化」觀察此因果關係。~Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at aerobic ammonia conversion.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.
units.verify: 用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「好氧區氨轉化」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for aerobic ammonia conversion; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 有足夠氧就能保證任意溫度下完全硝化。~Enough oxygen guarantees complete nitrification at any temperature.
units.practice: 先點選「好氧區氨轉化」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the aerobic ammonia conversion measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 無氧區電子供體：反硝化的電子供體需求~Anoxic electron donor: Electron-donor demand for denitrification
units.mechanism: 硝酸鹽還原需要電子供體；理論COD當量僅是起點，可利用碳、細胞產率與溶氧競爭會改變需求。本單元在「無氧區電子供體」觀察此因果關係。~Nitrate reduction needs an electron donor; theoretical COD equivalence is only a starting point because available carbon, growth and oxygen competition alter demand. Examine this relationship at anoxic electron donor.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待還原硝酸氮20 kg N/d、理論COD當量2.86 kg/kg N。公式 CODmin=2.86N；代入 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d。適用邊界：理論電子當量示範，不能當現場加藥劑量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: nitrate nitrogen20 kg N/d and theoretical COD equivalence2.86 kg/kg N. Formula CODmin=2.86N; substitution 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d. Boundary: Theoretical electron-equivalent illustration; not a field chemical dose.
units.verify: 同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「無氧區電子供體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for anoxic electron donor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總COD全都可以立即供反硝化使用。~All total COD is immediately available for denitrification.
units.practice: 先點選「無氧區電子供體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把硝酸氮改成25 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 71.5 kg COD/d。與基準 57.2 kg COD/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the anoxic electron donor measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only nitrate nitrogen to25 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 71.5 kg COD/d. Compare with baseline 57.2 kg COD/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 厭氧區磷循環：磷的轉移與污泥排出~Anaerobic phosphorus cycling: Phosphorus transfer and sludge export
units.mechanism: 除磷須將磷從水相轉入可排出的固體；生物吸收或化學沉澱不能取代最終排泥。本單元在「厭氧區磷循環」觀察此因果關係。~Phosphorus removal transfers phosphorus into solids that can leave the process; uptake or precipitation does not replace sludge export. Examine this relationship at anaerobic phosphorus cycling.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=1500 m³/d、進出水磷差ΔP=3 mg/L。公式 Mremoved=QΔP/1000；代入 1500*3/1000 = 4.5 kg P/d。適用邊界：水相表觀移除，尚需以污泥磷證實去向。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=1500 m³/d and phosphorus differenceΔP=3 mg/L. Formula Mremoved=QΔP/1000; substitution 1500*3/1000 = 4.5 kg P/d. Boundary: Apparent aqueous removal; sludge phosphorus must confirm the destination.
units.verify: 同時量測溶解態與總磷、污泥含磷率及排泥量。在離線場景為「厭氧區磷循環」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure dissolved and total phosphorus, sludge phosphorus fraction and wasting rate together. Build an offline evidence table for anaerobic phosphorus cycling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 厭氧區帶入硝酸鹽可能干擾生物除磷；先查回流與碳源。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Nitrate entering an anaerobic zone can disrupt biological phosphorus removal; inspect recycle and carbon first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 水相磷下降就表示磷元素已被消滅。~Lower aqueous phosphorus means the element has been destroyed.
units.practice: 先點選「厭氧區磷循環」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把ΔP改成4 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 kg P/d。與基準 4.5 kg P/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the anaerobic phosphorus cycling measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ΔP to4 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 kg P/d. Compare with baseline 4.5 kg P/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 生物膜過濾床：生物膜過濾的水力負荷~Biofilm filter bed: Hydraulic loading of a biofilm filter
units.mechanism: 通過濾床的水量除以有效面積得到表觀濾速；同一流量遇到停用格或堵塞，剩餘濾格負擔會升高。本單元在「生物膜過濾床」觀察此因果關係。~Flow through a bed divided by active area gives superficial filtration velocity; offline or blocked cells increase loading on the remaining cells. Examine this relationship at biofilm filter bed.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：流量240 m³/h、可用濾床面積80 m²。公式 vf=Q/A；代入 240/80 = 3 m/h。適用邊界：僅為液體表觀濾速，不代替生物反應、氣水逆洗或實際孔隙速度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: flow240 m³/h and active filter area80 m². Formula vf=Q/A; substitution 240/80 = 3 m/h. Boundary: Superficial liquid velocity only; biological kinetics, air-water backwash and pore velocity are separate.
units.verify: 同時讀流量、濾前後水位及濁度，記錄停用濾格與反洗時段。在離線場景為「生物膜過濾床」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Read flow, upstream/downstream level and turbidity together; log offline cells and backwash periods. Build an offline evidence table for biofilm filter bed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 未扣反洗中的濾格會低估運轉負荷；先重算可用面積。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting a backwashing cell understates operating loading; recompute active area first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濾床越深，同一流量下表觀濾速必然越低。~A deeper bed necessarily lowers superficial velocity at equal flow.
units.practice: 先點選「生物膜過濾床」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用面積降到60 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4 m/h。與基準 3 m/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the biofilm filter bed measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active area to60 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4 m/h. Compare with baseline 3 m/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 回用水臭氧子系統：臭氧轉移與接觸收支~Reuse-water ozone subsystem: Ozone transfer and contact balance
units.mechanism: 注入氣體不等於全部進入水中；尾氣與溶解臭氧共同約束實際轉移量。本單元在「回用水臭氧子系統」觀察此因果關係。~Injected gas is not entirely transferred to water; off-gas and dissolved ozone constrain actual transferred mass. Examine this relationship at reuse-water ozone subsystem.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想注入2 kg/h、轉移效率0.75、Q=500 m³/h。公式 Dtransferred=1000Minη/Q；代入 1000*2*0.75/500 = 3 mg/L。適用邊界：質量轉移示範，不是消毒信用或微污染物破壞保證。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical injection2 kg/h, transfer efficiency0.75 andQ=500 m³/h. Formula Dtransferred=1000Minη/Q; substitution 1000*2*0.75/500 = 3 mg/L. Boundary: Mass-transfer illustration, not disinfection credit or guaranteed micropollutant destruction.
units.verify: 量測尾氣並檢查溴化物與副產物資料，建立目標化合物驗證。在離線場景為「回用水臭氧子系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure off-gas, review bromide and by-product data and validate the target compound. Build an offline evidence table for reuse-water ozone subsystem; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 水質氧化需求升高會降低目標物可用的氧化能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Higher water-matrix demand reduces oxidation available to the target compound. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 注入的每公斤臭氧都有效破壞目標污染物。~Every kilogram injected effectively destroys the target pollutant.
units.practice: 先點選「回用水臭氧子系統」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把轉移效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 mg/L。與基準 3 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the reuse-water ozone subsystem measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 mg/L. Compare with baseline 3 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 建築沖廁需求配對：回用水混合與需求配對~Building-flushing demand: Reuse blending and demand matching
units.mechanism: 混合濃度由各水流的質量加權，而不是簡單平均；不同用途的需求與品質應分別核對。本單元在「建築沖廁需求配對」觀察此因果關係。~Blended concentration is mass weighted rather than a simple average; quality and demand must be checked separately for each reuse. Examine this relationship at building-flushing demand.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q1=80、Q2=20 m³/h；C1=5、C2=100 mg/L。公式 Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)；代入 (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L。適用邊界：同一可加成保守溶質；微生物風險與化學相容性不能僅靠此式判斷。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q1=80 and Q2=20 m³/h; C1=5 and C2=100 mg/L. Formula Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2); substitution (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L. Boundary: One additive conservative solute; microbial risk and chemical compatibility cannot be established by this formula.
units.verify: 檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「建築沖廁需求配對」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for building-flushing demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 兩股不同流量的濃度總可直接取平均。~Concentrations of unequal flows can always be averaged directly.
units.practice: 先點選「建築沖廁需求配對」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the building-flushing demand measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 處理與回用儀表：感測器偏移校正~Treatment/reuse instruments: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「處理與回用儀表」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at treatment/reuse instruments.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「處理與回用儀表」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for treatment/reuse instruments; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「處理與回用儀表」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the treatment/reuse instruments measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

sources.title: 有明水再生中心

history: 東京都下水道局介紹有明採A₂O和生物膜過濾，部分水另經臭氧或纖維過濾供沖廁與清洗等用途。~Tokyo Sewerage describes A₂O and biofilm filtration at Ariake, with part of the water further ozonated or fiber-filtered for toilet flushing and washing.
